scientific_purpose: Secondary mitigation experiment related to RQ7: estimate the alignment and coverage trade-off of equal-weight cross-judge aggregation. It neither replaces RQ7 nor makes a direct comparison with DUAL_SWAP without a later genuinely matched population.

population.canonical_pair_key_serialization: UTF-8 JSON array in that field order, with JSON separators ',' and ':' and no whitespace.

original_answer_identity.ORIGINAL_ANSWER_1: the lower immutable original answer ID in the canonical pair
original_answer_identity.ORIGINAL_ANSWER_2: the higher immutable original answer ID in the canonical pair

eligibility: usable canonical human-reference label in {ANSWER_1, ANSWER_2, TIE}

execution_plan.reason_not_dual_swap: This is cross-judge aggregation, not within-judge presentation-consistency filtering.

presentation_assignment.per_pair_constraint: Exactly two judges receive AB and exactly two judges receive BA for every canonical pair.

deterministic_algorithm.pair_order: Sort canonical-pair-key serializations by ascending SHA-256 hex digest of UTF-8 'multi-judge-consensus-v1|20260823|' + canonical_pair_key_serialization; break an impossible digest tie by the canonical-pair-key serialization.
deterministic_algorithm.judge_quota: Rank judge IDs by ascending SHA-256 hex digest of UTF-8 'multi-judge-consensus-v1|20260823|quota|' + judge_id; break a digest tie by judge ID. The first two receive AB quota 806 and the other two receive AB quota 805; BA quota is 1611 minus each judge's AB quota.
deterministic_algorithm.assignment: Choose a feasible binary assignment x[pair,judge] with sum_j x[pair,judge]=2 for every pair and sum_pair x[pair,judge]=the judge AB quota. x=1 denotes AB; x=0 denotes BA.
deterministic_algorithm.secondary_category_balance: Among feasible assignments, minimize the sum across category and judge of absolute(AB_count - category_pair_count/2).
deterministic_algorithm.stable_tie_break: Among equal category-balance assignments, minimize the lexicographic vector of SHA-256 hex digests of UTF-8 'multi-judge-consensus-v1|20260823|' + canonical_pair_key_serialization + '|' + judge_id in canonical pair order and ascending judge-ID order; break an impossible digest tie by the corresponding judge-ID bit vector.

vote_mapping.map_displayed_A_to: the original answer ID presented as A, then canonicalize to ORIGINAL_ANSWER_1 or ORIGINAL_ANSWER_2
vote_mapping.map_displayed_B_to: the original answer ID presented as B, then canonicalize to ORIGINAL_ANSWER_1 or ORIGINAL_ANSWER_2

primary_consensus.name: STRICT_FOUR_JUDGE_SUPERMAJORITY
primary_consensus.decision_rule: A consensus decision exists only when all four judges cast valid scientific votes and at least three choose the same mapped three-class label.

tie_handling.consensus_tie_rule: Three or four TIE votes are a valid consensus TIE.

primary_coverage.numerator: planned pairs with consensus outcome ANSWER_1, ANSWER_2, or TIE

primary_outcome.estimand: Three-class agreement of a primary consensus decision with the canonical human-reference label among pairs with a primary consensus decision.
primary_outcome.numerator: consensus label equals canonical human-reference label
primary_outcome.denominator: pairs with a primary consensus decision and usable frozen human reference
primary_outcome.interpretation_limit: Human preferences are reference labels, not ground truth.

primary_comparator.population: the exact pairs retained by the primary consensus analysis
primary_comparator.per_judge_measure: three-class agreement with the human-reference label
primary_comparator.aggregate: equal-weight mean of the four individual-judge agreements; each judge has weight 1/4
primary_comparator.primary_delta: consensus agreement minus equal-weight individual-judge agreement on the same consensus-covered pairs
forbidden: historical baseline comparison with a different denominator

three_valid_judge_sensitivity.label: THREE-VALID-JUDGE SENSITIVITY
three_valid_judge_sensitivity.eligible_only_when: exactly three judges have valid scientific votes
report: delta versus corresponding same-pair individual baseline

uncertainty.matched_delta_resampling: Resample complete pair-level comparison records, preserving all four votes and the consensus result together.
uncertainty.forbidden: Do not bootstrap individual passes independently.

post_hoc_prohibitions: adopt plurality because it performs better
choose a seed based on outcomes
dual_swap_rule: Any later direct DUAL_SWAP versus multi-judge delta requires a genuinely matched common population; otherwise report separate operating points only.
